remarks: This was an unseen bird which sang this song, or very similar variations, repeatedly. Similar song is common in the area. I believe that it is a Bewick's Wren, but it is different enough from other recordings that I would greatly appreciate some corroboration. Habitat is dry montane scrub, with a significant over-story of oak and evergreen. This recording was made near the edge of the draw above Boot Spring. Recording filtered below 500 Hz.
